Tamil Nadu Govt Faces Allegations Over High-Cost Power Procurement

The Tamil Nadu government is facing allegations of corruption and a scam related to power procurement at a rate of Rs 35 per unit. Edappadi K. Palaniswami, an opposition leader, accused the current government of orchestrating this deal. Senthil Balaji, associated with the government, is also named in connection with the alleged corruption. The procurement rate of Rs 35 per unit is described as costly and has drawn criticism.
